title: Visiting Fellow in Dermatologic Laser Surgery
inst: Faculty of Medicine Ramathibodi Hospital, Mahidol University
Department: Division of Dermatology (via International Relations Section)
Duration: Programme fee quoted per 1 month (4 weeks); sessions start the first or third week of each month
Start: First or third week of every month except April
Deadline: Apply at least three months before the intended start date
Eligibility: Dermatologist with at least 10 months of training in general dermatology from an accredited institution; communicative English (TOEFL/IELTS score required); recommendation letter, CV, cover letter, dermatology certificate/diploma
International applicants: Yes - programme run by the International Relations Section for overseas dermatologists
Application method: Online application (Google Form) with attached documents; acceptance notified by email from Ramathibodi International Relations
Positions: Two applicants accepted at a time per training session
Funding: Self-funded - tuition 2,000 USD per month, paid by bank transfer within two weeks of acceptance
Visa support: Page states international participants require a Non-Immigrant Education (ED) visa, arranged by the applicant at a Royal Thai Embassy/Consulate; copy required after acceptance
Summary: Short visiting fellowship for dermatologists covering laser and light systems and procedures such as botulinum toxin, fillers, grafts, hair transplantation, peels and photodynamic therapy through case discussion, live demonstration and supervised practice.

title: Clinical Fellowship Program in Family Medicine
inst: Faculty of Medicine Ramathibodi Hospital, Mahidol University
Eligibility: Post-residency physicians (training in specific areas after residency)
International applicants: Not stated for the 1-year fellowship; the department states it accepts international resident physicians for 1-2 month elective rotations (additional fee may apply) and offers tailor-made fellowships for attending physicians through international partnerships
Application method: Contact the department (international enquiries: Dr Jitsaphan, jitsaphan.cho@mahidol.ac.th)
Funding: Not stated on official page (additional fee may apply for international electives)
Summary: The Department of Family Medicine at Ramathibodi offers a one-year clinical fellowship for post-residency training in specific areas of family medicine, alongside residency and elective programmes.

title: Khon Kaen Clinical Fellowship for Sports Medicine
inst: Srinagarind Hospital, Faculty of Medicine, Khon Kaen University
Eligibility: Orthopaedic surgeons; the listing notes the programme is suitable for Thai fellows interested in cadaver laboratory and biomedical engineering research
International applicants: Not stated on official page (programme described as suitable for Thai fellows; centre states it can customise educational opportunities)
Accreditation: ISAKOS fellowship directory listing (information provided by the centre; ISAKOS-listed programme)
Application method: Direct application to the programme chair (Artit Boonrod, MD)
Summary: Twelve-month sports medicine fellowship at Srinagarind Hospital, Khon Kaen University, aimed at enhancing surgical skills in shoulder, elbow and knee procedures with cadaver laboratory and biomedical engineering research opportunities.
